market.question: Who will win in the upcoming wta event Alice Tubello vs Bianca Andreescu scheduled for November 6, 2026 at 4:00 PM UTC?
market.description: This market will settle to the winner of the Alice Tubello vs Bianca Andreescu WTA match scheduled for November 6, 2026 at 11:00AM ET (as of the listing of the event's first instrument). If the match does not begin due to a walkover, withdrawal, or cancellation, the market will settle to the last fair market price. If a player retires or is disqualified during the match, the market will settle to the official winner of the match. If the match is delayed, postponed, suspended or otherwise rescheduled to a date and time not within two days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from WTA.
